title: Controlling family publicly ruled out any sale

input.facts: Molecular diagnostics instruments with reagent pull-through; recurring revenue 60% of sales. Share price down 27% over twelve months on a slower-than-expected recovery of testing volumes, which management expects to normalise. The Bergmann family holds 52%; in the H1 release the chairman stated that the family will remain the long-term majority owner and that the company is not for sale. Leverage 1.2x. No regulatory issue.

why: A controlling shareholder who ruled out a sale is a kill criterion. Reject, even though the business itself fits.
